definitions.explanation: The upper layer of ground where plants grow.
The solid surface of the earth.

examples.english: To plant seeds in the soil.

examples.japanese: {土|つち}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{乾|かわ}いている→乾く：00786_kawaku⟧。

examples.english: I put soil in the flower pot.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧{土|つち}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{栄養|えいよう}→栄養：01882_eiyou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{豊富|ほうふ}→豊富：03620_houfu⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: This soil is rich in nutrients.

examples.japanese: ⟦{靴|くつ}→靴：00725_kutsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{土|つち}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ついている→付く：01960_tsuku⟧。
⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{土|つち}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{遊|あそ}んでいる→遊ぶ：00550_asobu⟧。

examples.english: Please brush off the dirt before entering the room.

notes:
{土|つち} refers to soil, earth, or dirt—the material that covers the ground and in which plants grow.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {土|つち}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{掘|ほ}る→掘る：00442_horu⟧: to dig soil
- {土|つち}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{種|たね}→種：02157_tane⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{蒔|ま}く→蒔く：02419_maku⟧: to sow seeds in soil
- {土|つち}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{乾|かわ}く→乾く：00786_kawaku⟧: the soil dries out
- {土|つち}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦つく→付く：01960_tsuku⟧: to get dirt on (clothes, etc.)

COMPOUNDS:
- ⟦{土地|とち}→土地：02226_tochi⟧: land, property
- ⟦{土曜日|どようび}→土曜日：00621_doyoubi⟧: Saturday
- ⟦{土産|みやげ}→土産：03746_miyage⟧: souvenir (regional product)
- ⟦{粘土|ねんど}→粘土：19435_nendo⟧: clay
- ⟦{土砂|どしゃ}→土砂：17540_dosha⟧: earth and sand
- ⟦{赤土|あかつち}→赤土：28004_akatsuchi⟧: red clay

CULTURAL NOTE:
{土|つち} is one of the five elements (⟦{五行|ごぎょう}→五行：28111_gogyou⟧) in East Asian philosophy: ⟦{木|き}→木：00524_ki⟧ (wood), ⟦{火|ひ}→火：02248_hi⟧ (fire), {土|つち} (earth), ⟦{金|きん}→金：02666_kin⟧ (metal), ⟦{水|みず}→水：02258_mizu⟧ (water).

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{地面|じめん}→地面：00125_jimen⟧: ground, surface
- ⟦{大地|だいち}→大地：12187_daichi⟧: earth, ground (larger scale)
